Both give the same type of sign-swapping counterexample and repair the step by using absolute-value vectors.

component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction supplies the corresponding sign-swapping example and specifically repairs the proof by applying the order-statistics lemma to absolute-value vectors.
